about: Recommended local models. Sizes are the approximate download size of the default quantization in the Ollama library at the time of writing; once installed, the studio uses the real size reported by your runtime. You can install any other compatible model by name.

presets.label: Fast
presets.strengths: Quick classification, extraction, summaries and simple edits. Good JSON compliance.

presets.label: Balanced (recommended main model)
presets.strengths: Solid game-design reasoning and structured output with room for 16–32k context on a 24 GB Mac.

presets.label: Best quality that fits a 24 GB Mac
presets.strengths: Strongest reasoning in this size class; mixture-of-experts so it runs fast. Use 8–16k context on 24 GB.

presets.label: Coding specialist
presets.strengths: Best for writing custom game modules (JavaScript) and formula-heavy patches.

presets.label: Alternative main model
presets.strengths: Good writing for events and flavor text; can also read screenshots (vision) for the UX critic.

presets.label: Large (needs a higher GPU memory limit)
presets.strengths: Higher quality, but on 24 GB it exceeds the default GPU budget. Only for advanced users who raise iogpu.wired_limit_mb.
